'''Goodbye, Friend!''' (Japanese: '''さよなら、ラビフット！''' ''Goodbye, {{tt|Rabbifuto|Raboot}}!'') is the seventh chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN022|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] visit [[Hoenn]] again.
* Goh tries to {{pkmn2|released|release}} {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}, but then changes his mind.
* Goh and Raboot settle their differences and reconcile from [[JNM06|their previous argument]].
